name: MTDC Holiday Resort Ajanta (Fardapur)
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's resort at Fardapur 4 km from the Ajanta Caves entrance — A/C and non-A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation at the cave gate. Books out for school-tour season (Nov–Feb).

name: Hotel Ajanta Heritage Jalgaon
location: Mahabal Road, Jalgaon (60 km from Ajanta)
why_special: Senior Jalgaon mid-range 3-star — multi-cuisine restaurant, 90-min drive to Ajanta T-Point. The Jalgaon-side base for travellers approaching Ajanta from the Bhusaval rail head, faster than the 100-km Aurangabad approach.
